input.label: basic_learning
input.rationale: The item asks students to match a short, clearly worded intake table to one named disorder category (generalized anxiety disorder). The table gives the defining features (chronic, multi-topic worry for 8+ months, muscle tension, restlessness, sleep trouble). It also rules out the near-miss categories: no panic episodes, no avoidance of specific places or objects, and no rituals. Each distractor misreads one feature, and none is defensible as a second answer. Only one concept is applied, with a single pass of table reading and no calculation. The vocabulary stays within the Topic 5.4 anxiety disorders. This is a basic application of one named concept to a scenario with light elimination of near-miss options, so it suits early learning more than full-mock exam prep.
